summary.intent: Execute Phase 20 (vault-migration) of cipher-box, implementing v2 vault blob format across the API, Rust desktop app, and web client, then perform security review, code simplification, and human checkpoint verification.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans executed successfully; 2 high-severity security issues fixed; 3 bugs found during UAT and fixed (v2 blob sync parsing, recovery tool error handling, IPNS resolution); checkpoint verification partially complete with CORS blocking full recovery tool IPNS resolution in local dev.

repo: orval generates `{ [key: string]: unknown } | null` for nullable string fields instead of `string | null` — `as unknown as string` casts are the correct workaround, not a code smell
NestJS does not auto-log incoming request routes — POST /vault/migrate succeeded silently, making it appear the migration never ran when inspecting server output
Vault migration state is tracked via `migrated_at` and `has_key` columns in the vault entity; `has_key = false` after migration means crypto columns are NULLed
IPFS gateway at 192.168.133.114:8080 is exposed and serves content, but Kubo API port 5001 does not send CORS headers, blocking browser access
The delegated routing API (`/routing/v1/ipns/{name}`) returns CBOR-wrapped records, not raw protobuf — `extractCidFromIpnsRecord` must not attempt raw protobuf parsing on this response
IPNS records published to a local Kubo node do not propagate to the public DHT — public gateways cannot resolve them

code.finding: fetchAndDecryptMetadata blindly JSON.parsed IPFS blob bytes without detecting v2 binary format — crashes with SyntaxError on migrated users whose IPFS record holds a v2 blob
Same v2 blob detection bug as folder.service.ts — SDK fetch path also tried to JSON.parse raw binary
Migration IIFE called deriveVaultIpnsKeypair() twice with identical inputs; hoisting the call above try/catch eliminated the redundant derivation

fetchFromIpfs could return undefined on non-2xx/non-404 responses (loop fell through without returning), causing detectBlobVersion to crash with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')`
Desktop vault init ECIES-wrapped rootFolderKey twice with the same public key — once for DB storage and once for v2 blob — wasting a full ECIES operation
InitVaultRequest and VaultResponse used derived Debug — printed encrypted key material in plaintext to logs; replaced with custom Debug impls that redact sensitive fields
serializeVaultBlobV2 accepted any-length key arrays; u16 truncation on key length > 65535 was silent — added explicit bounds check returning an error

workflow: GSD wave-based execution: Wave 1 (foundation module) must complete before Wave 2 (API + Rust) can run in parallel; Wave 3 (web client) depends on both
Security review during checkpoint pause (while awaiting human verification) is an efficient use of wall time — no blocking
Playwright browser automation is useful for UAT during checkpoints: can retrieve OTPs from server logs, inspect console messages, and navigate the app
When NestJS API calls appear to not execute, query the database directly to verify state before assuming failure
gsd-debugger with console instrumentation + Playwright session replay is an effective pattern for diagnosing silent IIFE failures in browser code

friction: API connection error (ConnectionRefused) aborted the first security review attempt, requiring a full retry
NestJS silent request logging caused significant wasted investigation time — migration appeared to fail when it had actually succeeded
orval codegen bug with nullable string fields forced `as unknown as string` casts that look like bugs but are required
Kubo API port 5001 has no CORS headers, making browser-based IPNS resolution impossible without a proxy
Local IPNS records don't propagate to public DHT, so public gateways (ipfs.io, delegated-ipfs.dev) cannot resolve them in local dev
Recovery tool IPNS resolution required multiple fix iterations: raw protobuf parsing of CBOR response, missing null guard on fetchFromIpfs, CORS blocking Kubo fallback
open_items: Recovery tool private key not zeroed from memory after use (M-1 from security review)
No deduplication guard on concurrent vault migration from multiple browser tabs (M-2 from security review)
ECIES re-wrap on every root folder FUSE publish — should cache wrapped key in AppState (M-3 from security review)
Zero-length key accepted by v2 blob deserializers without error (L-1 from security review)
No SRI hashes on CDN scripts in recovery.html (L-2 from security review)

Device registry sync fails with CryptoError: Invalid registry format — schema mismatch between current format and IPFS-stored records (todo: fix-device-registry-cryptoerror-invalid-registry-format.md)
Bin IPNS name 404 resolution failure — pre-existing issue (todo: fix-bin-ipns-name-404-resolution-failure.md)
Recovery tool CipherBox API IPNS fallback added but not fully verified end-to-end
Phase 20 checkpoint approved and verification not yet run — phase completion, ROADMAP/STATE update, and PROJECT.md evolution still pending
